author: Benjamin Geoffroy Dit Belhumeur
title: Children's Picture Book Illustrator Wanted: First Book of a New Series
content: Belhumeur Books is looking for an illustrator for the first book in a new children's picture book series, and we want it to be the start of a long partnership, not a one-off gig. We have steady book work planned well beyond this first title: the right illustrator will have ongoing commissions for the foreseeable future. The project: ~640 words, 14 full spreads + cover, 8.5" × 8.5" paperback. Warm, playful, family-centered, told entirely in first-person visuals. We're after soft, expressive, cinematic storytelling; classic picture-book charm with real emotional range. Who we're looking for: An emerging illustrator ready to earn their first picture book credit, or add a strong title to an existing portfolio. You need to draw the same characters, animals, and settings again and again, different scenes, different angles, and keep them recognizable every time. Strong sequential storytelling across full spreads. Pay: $3,000 flat for book one, in four $750 milestones (signing / approved thumbnails & character designs / approved finished illustrations / print-ready delivery). Two shortlisted finalists each get $100 for a paid test. Future books come with paid commissions and the opportunity to negotiate ongoing royalty participation. Prominent cover and title-page credit. Timeline: Hire by November 1, 2026; Thumbnails ~December 15; Finished art ~February 1, 2027; Print-ready ~March 1, 2027. To apply: Email belhumeur.books@gmail.com with your portfolio link, 3–5 samples showing the same characters across multiple scenes and angles plus sequential pages, a sentence or two about yourself, your availability, and confirmation your work is original and human-made (no generative AI).

author: Craig Groshek
title: Horror Illustrators Wanted — Paid Opportunities
content: HORROR ILLUSTRATORS WANTED — PAID OPPORTUNITIES. Chilling Tales for Dark Nights is looking for a handful of talented horror illustrators to create original artwork for us throughout the remainder of 2026 and into 2027. If you have a talent for bringing nightmares to life—from unsettling atmosphere to terrifying creatures—we’d love to see your work. Experience with illustrated lettering or incorporating text into your artwork is a plus, but not required. These are paid gigs. We’re seeking human-created artwork only for this particular endeavor. We won’t accept AI-generated or AI-assisted artwork. Interested? Email Craig Groshek with your portfolio, rates, and availability: Email: craiggroshek@chillingtalesfordarknights.com Subject line: CTFDN ARTIST INTEREST. Know a talented artist who would be a great fit? Tag them below or share this post to help us find them!

title: Looking for a long-term artist for weekly character art
content: **(ENG/TAG OK!) LOOKING FOR A LONG-TERM ARTIST!** Hello! I'm an ASMR RP creator on YouTube based overseas, and I'm looking for a reliable long-term artist to work with on a weekly basis for thumbnails and videos! I'm currently working with a limited budget, so I'm hoping to find an artist whose rates are a good fit for ongoing weekly commissions! I'm looking for: * Weekly character art - 1x Simple rendered anime-style bust up or half body art of my OC per week (hopefully to be expanded to full body eventually once my income & budget increases!) * Expression variations - Multiple facial expressions on the same art base - PSD file organized into separate layers for eyes/mouth/eyebrows/etc. for ability to mix & match * Occasional additional elements - Small add-ons may be requested (such as a tear overlay, hand caressing the face, etc.). Additional compensation can be discussed. Ideally, I'd love to have each illustration to be completed within a week of providing the script + directions. However I am very happy to discuss a timeline that works best with both of us, as long as we can maintain a consistent weekly schedule ^^ Please only respond if you: * Are over the age of 18 * Have read through this post all the way (please add ANY flower emoji to your reply) * Can reliably commit to weekly commissions and deliver them on time! If you're interested, please feel free to reply with your commission rates and relevant examples of your work! I will be reaching out via DM for further discussions :) (You might have to check spam coz this is like a brand new account I made for anonymity LOL)
